title: Russian Police Arrest 3 Suspected VasyGrek Hackers, Dismantle Criminal Infrastructure
summary: Russian authorities have arrested three suspected members of a threat group known as VasyGrek and dismantled its criminal infrastructure.
card_summary: Russian authorities have arrested three suspected members of a threat group known as VasyGrek and dismantled its criminal infrastructure.

sections.impact:
Also known as Fluffy Wolf, the threat actor has a history of targeting Russian and international companies since 2016.

Assessed severity: MEDIUM.

title: Google Issues Patches for Critical Android Flaw That Could Allow RCE Without User Interaction
summary: A critical Android flaw could allow an attacker to run code on a phone without any user action remotely, Google said in its November security bulletin.
card_summary: A critical Android flaw could allow an attacker to run code on a phone without any user action remotely, Google said in its November security bulletin.

title: CISA Confirms Hackers Exploiting WordPress Core Flaw During Software Upgrades
summary: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added a security flaw in WordPress Core to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation.
card_summary: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added a security flaw in WordPress Core to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation.

title: mSecure Warns Users to Change Passwords, Reset 2FA and Passkeys After Suspicious Activity
summary: Customers of the mSecure password manager are being urged to act now to protect the confidential information they store in it, possibly by changing passwords, resetting two-factor authentication (2FA), and removing passkeys.
card_summary: Customers of the mSecure password manager are being urged to act now to protect the confidential information they store in it, possibly by changing passwords, resetting two-factor authentication (2FA), and removing passkeys.

email_summary: Customers of the mSecure password manager are being urged to act now to protect the confidential information they store in it, possibly by changing passwords, resetting two-factor authentication (2FA), and removing passkeys. The warning came in an email sent on November 3 in the name of developer mSeven Software.
